steps.text: Once generated, a participant's sworn statement (Annex 8) is waiting for their signature. Instead of printing it and sending it back, the participant can **sign it electronically** in the app.
steps.title: The document to be signed

steps.text: Click **"Request signature"**. The participant is invited to sign: they receive a notification and an email, and the document appears in their "To sign" menu.
steps.title: Request the signature

steps.text: The document shows **"Signature requested"**. Once the participant has signed, it switches to "Signed electronically" and the signed PDF becomes its final version, with nothing to upload.
steps.title: The signature is requested

steps.text: The **"Follow"** link opens the request's page: who has to sign, where they stand, and its history. Every request of the community is also in the "Signatures" menu.
steps.title: Follow the request
